title: Chat with a business
headline: Chat with *a business*
sub: One chat with the business, in the app: ask, and it answers.

flow.purpose: a customer who already uses it
flow.action: At her office desk, glances at her phone, laughs and types a short reply with one hand while holding a lunch bag
flow.setting: Tobi's desk at a logistics office in Yaba, Lagos: a laptop, a paper cup of zobo, a window on the street

flow.action: Wipes her hands on her apron, reads her phone and types a reply with a quick smile
flow.setting: Ada's Kitchen in Yaba, Lagos: white tiles, steel counters, big steaming pots, a bright window on a yellow-painted wall

en: Open Ada's Kitchen's chat link. It shows her card.
Tap Chat. The chat opens, with a note on what Ada sees.
She asks about offers. Tap Not now.
Tap the box and type your question.
Ada replies in the same chat, with her prices.
